caption: The drawing is done in shades of gray on an off-white background and features a large pewter tankard with a hinged lid as the central object. The tankard has a smooth, slightly flared cylindrical body with two horizontal ridges near the bottom, a domed lid, and a curved handle with ornamental ridges and a small thumb lift at the top. The handle attaches to the tankard at the upper rim and curves downward in a wide arc. There are two smaller inset drawings: one in the upper right corner shows a detailed segment of a stepped decorative molding, and another in the lower left corner contains a crest featuring a boar's head facing left, surrounded by leafy branches and crossed sticks or spears. The entire composition is neatly enclosed by a single-line rectangular border.
title: Silver Tankard
